name: Alfred Creswell
original_name: アルフレッド クレスウェル
source:
[i]"Listening to the thoughts of those who call this country home is part of my duty. I'm glad I got to hear what you had to say today."[/i]

The present head of the Creswell house, descendant of the Spriggan. A serious and strict person. Always thinking one step ahead, he’s the typical adviser type who speaks logically.

He can show signs of brittleness if things suddenly don’t go the way he expected, and sometimes finds himself putting on a bold front. He’s the type of person to use anything at his disposal.

He’s concerned about the future of the country, and the weakening existence of the mingles.

[i]"I believe you have opinions about the Five Houses—perhaps even this nation as a whole. If that’s the case then we can surely work together, can't we?"[/i]

Alfred is trying to bring together other talented workers and encouraging them to work together.
After having the chance to make conversation with him on many occasions, the protagonist begins to suspect that Alfred is looking into her.

One day, the protagonist sees him sneaking around town, disguised. Finding that strange, she follows him, only to discover his unexpected true identity...

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/mistonia/characters/alfred/]Aksys Games[/url]]
